help.title: Help
help.about1: Citizen Graph tells you what to bring, what it costs and where to go for city services.
help.about2: It is a thesis prototype. It is not an official government app and it does not replace the office.
help.how1: Type what you need, or pick a topic.
help.how2: Read the answer. Tick each paper when it is ready.
help.how3: Follow the steps and go to the office shown.
help.pendingTitle: If a list says it is being checked
help.pending: Some lists are still being confirmed with the office. We show no numbers for them. Please ask the office before you go.
help.privacy1: There is no login and no account.
help.privacy2: Lists you save and the items you tick stay on this phone only.
help.privacy3: Your questions are sent to the service so it can find the answer.
help.offline: You can read the lists you saved and your last answers with no signal. You need a signal to ask a new question.
help.sample: This prototype uses a small set of sample services from the published service charters of the city offices. Some are still being verified.
